description: The provided image is a two-level nested donut chart representing a task taxonomy, divided into an inner ring representing broad analytical layers and an outer ring detailing specific types of analysis within those layers. The chart consists of a total of 20 slices: 4 in the inner ring and 16 in the outer ring. The inner ring contains four slices that include text labels and exact percentage values directly inside the segments. Visually arranged roughly in descending order of size in a clockwise direction, these inner slices are: "Semantic Layer (41.2%)" colored in light blue-grey, "Perception Layer(40.4%)" in dark blue, "Cultural Layer (14.1%)" in light grey, and "Signal Layer(4.3%)" in medium blue. The outer ring provides further subdivisions without percentage labels, generally matching the color families of their corresponding inner layers. The "Semantic Layer" expands into three light blue-grey outer slices: "Content Analysis," "Emotion & Intention," and "Speaker Analysis." The "Perception Layer" is subdivided into six lighter medium-blue outer slices: "Environmental Perception & Reasoning," "Counting & Statistics," "Music Theory," "Correlation Analysis," "Temporal Analysis," and "Spatial Analysis." The "Cultural Layer" corresponds to four light grey outer slices: "Professional Knowl & Reasoning," "Culture of Speaker," "Imagination," and a very thin slice labeled "Asthetic Analysis." Finally, the "Signal Layer" corresponds to three medium blue outer slices: "Acoustic Quality Analysis," "AnomalyDetection," and a very thin slice labeled "Audio Difference Analysis." There is no separate legend, as all information is integrated directly onto or adjacent to the chart. The chart features a central blank circular hole, and while no slices are exploded or bolded, thin grey leader lines are utilized to connect the labels for "Asthetic Analysis" and "Audio Difference Analysis" to their visually narrow respective slices.
